title: 第八章 乱哄哄你方唱罢我登场
content_zh:
已是午时，贾珍着人点了一桌菜，手中拿着酒盅，唤了几个唱曲的伶妓，等待着贾蓉。
「老爷，蓉哥儿来了。」赖升引领着贾蓉，来到包厢。
「爹。」贾蓉进得包厢，开口唤了一声。
「嗯……」贾珍鼻子中发出长音，朝正在唱曲的伶妓挥了挥手，道：「去那玩耍了？」
贾蓉脸上堆着笑，道：「和冯家和陈家的几个朋友到西郊打猎去了，这才回来，可巧怕碰到您让人唤我，一刻不敢耽搁。」
「混帐的东西！」贾珍将酒盅狠狠放在桌案上，训斥道：「你也老大不小了，惯会一些狐朋狗友，飞鹰走狗，一天天不收个心，哪里有一点我贾家长房玄孙的样子！」
贾蓉吓得一哆嗦，垂下脑袋，讷讷不敢应，斜眼偷瞧了一眼贾珍，见其只是训斥一番，没有着人动手，心下才松了口气。
贾珍骂了一通，道：「你也年龄不小了，需得寻个亲事，为父看中了……工部营膳司郎中秦业家的姑娘，品容上佳，合为你良配。」
贾蓉眸中现出疑惑，静待其父下文。
「只是秦业家这姑娘，和后街柳条胡同的贾四儿，早定了婚约，听说你和那贾珩熟识，去给他五十两银子，让他悄摸摸退了这门亲事，不可声张。」贾珍吩咐道。
贾蓉道：「这……」
「怎麽，难办？」贾珍挑了挑眉，冷哼道。
贾蓉脸上挤出了笑容，道：「爹，好办是好办，那贾珩还巴结儿子呢，只是五十两，这贾珩他多半是不乐意，要是争执起来，儿子也不好办。」
贾珍冷哼一声，他岂不知这个儿子的鬼心思，不过，想起那秦家小姐的容貌丶身段，心头就是一热，从袖笼中取出一张银票，道：「这是二百两，若还是办不成，仔细你的皮！」
贾蓉躬身，双手上前接了，笑道：「爹，您就听儿子的好信儿吧。」
「赶紧滚！」贾珍骂了一句。
贾蓉这边，揣着银票，转身出了包厢，去往宁荣街的后廊去了。
且不说贾蓉去寻贾珩，却说贾珩回家之后，用罢午饭，换了一身武士劲装，就去往表兄董迁家借了一匹马，然后买了一些酒菜，向着安化门外的谢再义家赶去。
谢再义与他约好，在其五天一大休沐，三日一休沐之日，就在这空当，前往谢再义家，随其学骑射之术。
所谓骑射就是在高速疾驰的马上射箭，这哪怕是贾珩前世，在西南边防，都没有接触过。

毕竟，前世都是热兵器时代，对弓箭，并不怎麽使用，再加之西南边防的地理环境，也没有机会学这些。
如果，只是单纯骑马，倒也无虞。
一进谢家，谢再义也是刚刚用着午饭，一见贾珩，很是高兴，笑道：「我还道贾兄弟，怎麽早上没来？」
贾珩道：「上午去办了一些事。」
说着，将酒菜提给谢再义之妻。
二人简单用罢了饭菜，擦了擦嘴，谢再义在壁上，拿了两张弓并一壶箭，笑道：「贾老弟，我们往城外去练，那里开阔。」
贾珩应允下来，二骑就出了城，正是午后，秋日阳光柔和地照耀在大地之上，两骑策马行于旷原之间，行至一片蒿草丛深的荒原。
「贾老弟，你这骑术有功底啊。」谢再义见贾珩在马上身形灵巧，行止自如，出言夸赞道。
若是一个没有一点底子的，他想要从头教，就费了老劲，而若是有着骑术功底，他再从旁指点一段时间，假以时日，其必登堂入室。
贾珩道：「以前陪朋友随意练过，还要向谢兄请教。」
谢再义笑道：「其实，这骑射说难也不难，关键在于身丶眼丶手在马鞍上的协调，想来以贾老弟的底子，三个月应能练出来。」
而后，谢再义就向贾珩讲授骑射之要领，这一教就是两个时辰过去，直到夕阳西下，晚霞彤彤。
看着夕阳下的远山丶林子，贾珩感慨道：「当真是江山如画，一时多少豪杰。」
谢再义取了挂在马鞍上的牛皮袋，灌了一口酒，嘿嘿笑道：「老弟不像是个武夫，倒像是个文人。」
贾珩笑道：「纵古之名将，也有读书人，若为百人敌，自是不需，若帅师十万，为将略之才，则非知兵法，懂战策不可了。」
谢再义哈哈一笑，道：「老弟志向不小。」
贾珩也是一笑，道：「也不过随意感慨几句而已。」
揉了揉有些酸痛的手腕，将弓收起，笑道：「谢兄，不若在山林中打些野味？」
谢再义笑道：「一会儿天就黑了，山林行路不平，走，回去喝酒。」
贾珩笑了笑，也没有坚持。

二骑向安化门驰去，就要入得城中，天刚刚擦黑，忽地远处传来哒哒的马蹄声，一个头戴汉阳斗笠的小校，策马扬鞭，向着城门而来。
「是蓟镇的八百里急递。」谢再义脸上轻松笑意敛去，沉声道。
贾珩凝重道：「这莫非是出了什麽事？」
谢再义恨恨道：「一到入秋，北面的鞑子就自关口，略河北等地，蓟镇总兵这是来向朝廷求援了。」
陈汉承明之后，同样在边境设置九边，不过与前明不同，辽东已失，陈汉边事已经全面转入防御，好在，陈汉汲取着前明于宋的教训，将都城设置在长安城，此地得山川之固，倒也不会京都一夕三惊。
返回谢宅，由谢再义之妻做好饭菜，贾谢二人就是边饮酒，边谈及边事。
「贾老弟，你是不知，北边的鞑子年年越境抢掠杀戮，蓟镇总兵唐宽，龟缩在城中，坐视北平府治下百姓被劫掠，实在是混帐至极。」谢再义一边喝着酒，一边大骂着蓟镇总兵。
贾珩提起酒壶给谢再义斟了一杯酒，好奇道：「谢兄可和女真人对过阵？」
谢再义道：「怎麽没对阵过，当初老子就是杀了七个鞑子，才升得这百户，兄弟，哥哥给你说，这鞑子和我们有什麽两样，也是两个肩膀抗一个脑袋罢了，亏得那些总兵丶参将老爷，嚷嚷着鞑子不过万，满万不可敌。」
贾珩面现沉吟，暗道，这和前世晚明所面临之局势，几乎一般无二了。
只是，陈汉将都城定于长安，比前明又强了一些，只是陕西之地……流寇之乱。
「乱哄哄你方唱罢我登场，反认他乡是故乡。甚荒唐，到头来都是为他人作嫁衣裳。」
贾珩心念及此，不由悚然一惊。
《红楼梦》中甄士隐对好了歌的注解，当真是让人不寒而栗了。
「若贼寇起祸乱于内，关外之鞑虏犯境于外，趁陈汉势窘，而饮马黄河，席卷中原，这可不就是为他人作了嫁衣裳？」
贾珩叹了一口气，他如今来到这方红楼世界，恐怕还真只又有一条路走了，尽快掌权用事，不使这汉家天下丶华夏衣冠沉沦于鞑虏铁蹄之下。
「贾老弟，不说这些烦心之事，喝酒。」谢再义举起酒盅，冲贾珩示意。
贾珩笑了笑，也是举起酒盅，道：「国家大事，自有肉食者谋，我们还是喝酒吧。」
「是这个理儿，哈哈。」谢再义哈哈一笑，举起酒盅一饮而尽，许是酒气上涌，眼圈就有些红，夹了一口菜。
贾珩见着这一幕，心头暗叹，这也是有故事的人呐。

一场酒，吃到酉时方罢，贾珩向着家中走去。

content_en:
It was already noon. Jia Zhen ordered a table of dishes. With a wine cup in her hand, she called a few singing prostitutes and waited for Jia Rong.
"Master, Brother Rong is here." Lai Sheng led Jia Rong to the box.
"Dad." Jia Rong entered the box and called out.
"Well..." Jia Zhen made a long sound from her nose, waved her hand towards the prostitute who was singing, and said, "Are you going there to play?"
With a smile on her face, Jia Rong said: "I went hunting in the western suburbs with a few friends from the Feng family and Chen family, and I just came back. But I was afraid that I would be called by you, so I didn't dare to delay for a moment."
"You bastard!" Jia Zhen put the wine cup on the table and reprimanded: "You are not young anymore. You are used to having some bad friends, flying eagles and lackeys. You are not willing to accept it day by day. You don't look like the great-great-grandson of Jia's family!"
Jia Rong trembled with fright, lowered her head, and did not dare to respond. She glanced sideways at Jia Zhen, and was relieved when she saw that she just scolded her and no one took action.
Jia Zhen scolded her and said, "You are not young anymore. You need to find a match. My father has chosen her... a girl from Qin Ye's family who is a doctor in the Catering Department of the Ministry of Industry. She has good looks and is a good match for you."
Jia Rong had doubts in her eyes, waiting for her father to say more.
"It's just that this girl from Qin Ye's family has already made an engagement with Jia Si'er from Liutiao Hutong in the back street. I heard that you know Jia Heng well, so I went to give him fifty taels of silver and asked him to quietly cancel the marriage without making any announcement." Jia Zhen ordered.
Jia Rong said: "This..."
"What, is it difficult to do?" Jia Zhen raised her eyebrows and snorted coldly.
A smile appeared on Jia Rong's face and she said: "Dad, it's easy to handle, but Jia Heng is still fawning over his son. It's only fifty taels. Jia Heng is probably not happy. If there is a dispute, it will be difficult for his son."
Jia Zhen snorted coldly. Didn't he know what his son was thinking? However, thinking of the appearance and figure of Miss Qin's family, her heart felt hot. She took out a banknote from her sleeve and said, "This is two hundred taels. If you still can't do it, watch your skin carefully!"
Jia Rong bowed, took it with both hands, and said with a smile: "Dad, just listen to your son's good news."
"Get out of here!" Jia Zhen cursed.
Jia Rong, on his side, turned around and walked out of the box with the banknote in his pocket, heading to the back porch of Ningrong Street.
Not to mention that Jia Rong went to look for Jia Heng, but that after Jia Heng returned home, he had lunch, changed into a warrior uniform, borrowed a horse from his cousin Dong Qian's house, bought some food and wine, and rushed to Xie Zaiyi's house outside Anhua Gate.
Xie Zaiyi made an appointment with him to take one day off for five days and one day off for three days. During this free time, he went to Xie Zaiyi's home to learn the art of riding and archery from him.
The so-called mounted archery is shooting arrows on a high-speed horse. Even in Jia Heng's previous life, he had never been exposed to it when he was on the southwest border.
After all, the previous life was in the era of hot weapons, and bows and arrows were not used very much. In addition, due to the geographical environment of the southwest border defense, there was no chance to learn these.
If it's just riding a horse, there's no need to worry.
As soon as he entered Xie's house, Xie Zaiyi had just had lunch. When he saw Jia Heng, he was very happy and said with a smile, "Brother Jia, why didn't you come this morning?"
Jia Heng said: "I went to do some things this morning."
With that said, he brought the wine and food to Xie Zaiyi's wife.
The two simply finished their meal and wiped their mouths. Xie Zaiyi stood on the wall, took two bows and a pot of arrows, and said with a smile: "Brother Jia, let's go outside the city to practice. It's open there."
Jia Heng agreed, and the two cavalrymen left the city. It was afternoon, and the autumn sunshine was shining softly on the earth. The two cavalrymen rode through the wilderness and arrived at a wasteland deep in sagebrush.
"Brother Jia, you have good riding skills." Xie Zaiyi praised Jia Heng when he saw his dexterity and ease on the horse.
If he has no foundation at all, he will have to go through a lot of trouble to teach him from the beginning. But if he has riding skills, he will give you guidance for a while and pretend to be a master.In time, he will definitely enter the hall.
Jia Heng said: "I used to practice casually with my friends, and I also asked Brother Xie for advice."
Xie Zaiyi smiled and said, "Actually, this horseback shooting is not difficult at all. The key lies in the coordination of the body, eyes, and hands on the saddle. I think with Jia's background, I should be able to practice it in three months."
Then, Xie Zaiyi taught Jia Heng the essentials of riding and shooting. This teaching lasted for two hours until the sun set in the west and the sunset glowed brightly.
Looking at the distant mountains and woods under the setting sun, Jia Heng said with emotion: "The country is really picturesque, and there are so many heroes in one moment."
Xie Zaiyi took the cowhide bag hanging on the saddle, took a sip of wine, and said with a smile: "I don't look like a martial artist, but more like a scholar."
Jia Heng smiled and said: "Famous generals throughout the ancient times also had scholars. If the enemy is a hundred people, there is no need. If the commander has a hundred thousand soldiers and is a talented general, he must know the art of war and understand the battle strategy."
Xie Zaiyi laughed and said, "My ambition is not small."
Jia Heng also smiled and said, "It's just a few casual remarks."
He rubbed his sore wrist, put away his bow, and said with a smile, "Brother Xie, why don't you hunt some game in the forest?"
Xie Zaiyi smiled and said, "It will get dark soon. The road in the mountains and forests is uneven. Let's go back and have a drink."
Jia Heng smiled but did not insist.
The two cavalry galloped towards Anhua Gate and were about to enter the city. It was just getting dark when suddenly the sound of horse hooves came from the distance. A small school boy wearing a Hanyang bamboo hat, riding his horse and whipping his whip, came towards the city gate.
"It's the eight-hundred-mile express delivery from Ji Town." Xie Zaiyi said in a deep voice with a relaxed smile on his face.
Jia Heng said solemnly: "Could this be what happened?"
Xie Zaiyi said bitterly: "As soon as autumn comes, the Tatars from the north will come from the pass to Hebei and other places. The commander-in-chief of Ji Town has come to ask for help from the imperial court."
After the Chen and Han Dynasty accepted the Ming Dynasty, they also set up nine borders on the border. However, unlike the previous Ming Dynasty, Liaodong was lost, and the border affairs of Chen and Han Dynasties had been fully transferred to defense. Fortunately, Chen Han learned from the lessons of the previous Ming Dynasty and the Song Dynasty and set up the capital in Chang'an City. This place has strong mountains and rivers, so Kyoto will not be surprised overnight.
Returning to Xie's house, Xie Zaiyi's wife prepared the meal, and Jia and Xie drank and talked about things.
"Brother Jia, you don't know. The Tatars in the north cross the border every year to plunder and kill. Tang Kuan, the commander-in-chief of Ji Town, huddles in the city and watches the people under the rule of Beiping Prefecture being robbed. He is really a bastard." Xie Zaiyi drank wine while cursing the commander-in-chief of Ji Town.
Jia Heng picked up the jug and poured a glass of wine for Xie Zaiyi, and asked curiously: "Has Brother Xie ever fought against a Jurchen?"
Xie Zaiyi said: "Why haven't we fought against each other before? I killed seven Tatars before I was promoted to the hundred households. Brother, let me tell you, these Tatars are no different from us. They are just two shoulders against one head. Thanks to those generals and generals, they claim that the Tatars are only ten thousand, and they are invincible."
Jia Heng looked thoughtful and thought to himself, this situation is almost the same as the situation he faced in the late Ming Dynasty in his previous life.
However, Chen Han set the capital in Chang'an, which was stronger than the previous Ming Dynasty, but the land of Shaanxi... was in chaos with rogue bandits.
"You make a fuss about it, and then I come on stage after singing, but you think that a foreign country is your hometown. It's ridiculous. In the end, you are just making wedding clothes for others."
When Jia Heng thought about this, he couldn't help but be shocked.
Zhen Shiyin's annotation of the song in "A Dream of Red Mansions" is really chilling.
"If the bandits cause trouble within the country, and the Tartars outside the pass invade the country, and when the Chen and Han Dynasties are in a difficult situation, they drink the Yellow River and sweep across the Central Plains, is this not like making wedding clothes for others?"
Jia Heng sighed. Now that he has come to this world of Red Mansions, I am afraid that there is really only one way to go. He must take power as soon as possible and prevent the Han family and Chinese clothes from sinking under the iron hoof of the Tartars.
"Brother Jia, don't talk about these troublesome things and just drink." Xie Zaiyi raised the wine cup and motioned to Jia Heng.
Jia Heng smiled, raised the wine cup, and said, "The countryFamily matters have their own plans, so let’s just drink. "
"That's the truth, haha." Xie Zaiyi laughed, raised the wine cup and drank it all in one gulp. Perhaps because of the alcohol, his eye circles were a little red, and he took a mouthful of food.
Seeing this scene, Jia Heng sighed inwardly, this is also a person with a story.
After a long drinking session, Jia Heng walked home.
